title: Initial Confirmable retransmission timeout is between two and three seconds
natural_language: 在 RFC 7252 默认参数 ACK_TIMEOUT=2 s、ACK_RANDOM_FACTOR=1.5 下，CON 进入等待 ACK/RST 状态后，首次重传计时器不得早于 2000 ms，到 3000 ms 前应到期，除非匹配 ACK/RST 或显式取消已解除该义务。
standard_excerpt: the initial timeout is set to a random duration
time_source: RFC 7252 Table 2 defaults ACK_TIMEOUT=2 s and ACK_RANDOM_FACTOR=1.5
pointwise_semantics: strict pointwise; finite word; absolute integer milliseconds
finite_end_semantics: trace extends beyond 3000 ms; omitted APs are false

ap_definitions.coap_con_wait_started: The initial CON PDU is sent and its per-exchange retransmission node is inserted into the send queue.
ap_definitions.coap_first_retransmit_deadline_reached: Monotonic time reaches the absolute first-retransmission deadline stored for this queue-node generation, independently of when the callback is dispatched.
ap_definitions.coap_matching_ack_or_reset_received: coap_dispatch receives an ACK or RST whose endpoint and Message ID match the current exchange, and coap_remove_from_queue removes that exact queue-node generation.
ap_definitions.coap_attempt_cancelled: An allowed non-ACK/RST local cancellation path removes the current queue-node generation before its stored deadline.

correlation_key: local endpoint + remote endpoint + transport protocol + Message ID + queue-node generation
projection_rule: correlate one CON exchange before projection; endpoint and Message ID values remain event fields and never enter AP names
instrumentation_timing: emit the trigger after the node timeout and absolute queue deadline are committed; emit deadline-reached when monotonic time crosses that stored absolute deadline, not when the event-loop callback runs; emit discharge after queue removal
review_question: 确认采用 libcoap 默认传输参数，且 deadline AP 来自该 queue-node generation 已提交的绝对期限，而不是 callback dispatch 时刻。
limitations: RFC 7252 允许实际发送因节点调度而变晚；本性质核对已存储绝对期限的到达窗口，callback 与实际报文发送分别作为诊断和 MAX_TRANSMIT_SPAN 观测。
independent_audit_note: Root review required the bounded result to be the stored absolute deadline crossing, not callback dispatch, and confirmed early plus late/missing counterexamples.

title: The second retransmission timeout lies between four and six seconds
natural_language: 默认初始随机超时位于 2000--3000 ms；第一次重传完成后，计时器翻倍，所以第二次重传计时器不得早于 4000 ms，并应在 6000 ms 内到期或被 ACK/RST/取消解除。
standard_excerpt: the message is retransmitted, the retransmission counter is incremented, and the timeout is doubled
time_source: RFC 7252 doubling rule applied to the default 2000--3000 ms initial timeout
pointwise_semantics: strict pointwise; finite word; absolute integer milliseconds
finite_end_semantics: trace extends beyond 6000 ms; omitted APs are false

ap_definitions.coap_first_retransmission_completed: The first retransmission for the correlated CON is written and retransmit_cnt becomes 1 before the next deadline is queued.
ap_definitions.coap_second_retransmit_deadline_reached: Monotonic time reaches the next absolute deadline stored for the same queue-node generation after retransmit_cnt becomes 1, independently of callback dispatch.
ap_definitions.coap_matching_ack_or_reset_received: coap_dispatch receives an ACK or RST whose endpoint and Message ID match the current exchange, and coap_remove_from_queue removes that exact queue-node generation.
ap_definitions.coap_attempt_cancelled: An allowed non-ACK/RST local cancellation path removes the current queue-node generation before its stored deadline.

correlation_key: local endpoint + remote endpoint + transport protocol + Message ID + queue-node generation + retransmit_cnt
projection_rule: correlate one CON exchange and derive the cycle index from retransmit_cnt before projecting the fixed AP alphabet
instrumentation_timing: emit the trigger after retransmit_cnt increments and the next absolute deadline is committed; emit deadline-reached when monotonic time crosses that stored value, not when the callback runs
review_question: 确认默认 coap_context keepalive cap 未启用；启用该实现扩展时 next_delay 可能采用另一上限。
limitations: 公式验证默认参数下第二周期绝对期限的合法包络；初始随机值与后续精确二倍关系仍需由同一 queue node 的 timeout 字段关联核对。
independent_audit_note: Root review confirmed the second-cycle absolute deadline semantics and required a late/missing counterexample in addition to the early one.

title: After the fourth retransmission the final wait deadline is reached without a fifth send
category: final retransmission wait and retransmission limit
natural_language: 默认 MAX_RETRANSMIT=4。第四次重传完成后不得再发送第五次重传；若没有匹配 ACK/RST 或显式取消，该 generation 的 final-wait 绝对期限应在 32000--48000 ms 内到达，随后失败 callback 仅作为诊断动作记录。
standard_excerpt: the attempt to transmit the message is canceled and the application process informed of failure
time_source: RFC 7252 default MAX_RETRANSMIT and four applications of the doubling rule
pointwise_semantics: strict pointwise; finite word; absolute integer milliseconds
finite_end_semantics: trace extends beyond 48000 ms; omitted APs are false

ap_definitions.coap_fourth_retransmission_completed: The correlated CON has just been retransmitted with retransmit_cnt incremented to 4 and its final wait is queued.
ap_definitions.coap_final_wait_deadline_reached: Monotonic time reaches the absolute final-wait deadline stored after retransmit_cnt becomes 4, before any event-loop dispatch or nack callback completion.
ap_definitions.coap_matching_ack_or_reset_received: coap_dispatch receives an ACK or RST whose endpoint and Message ID match the current exchange, and coap_remove_from_queue removes that exact queue-node generation.
ap_definitions.coap_attempt_cancelled: An allowed non-ACK/RST local cancellation path removes the current queue-node generation before its stored deadline.
ap_definitions.coap_fifth_retransmission_sent: A fifth network send is performed for the same queue-node generation; this must remain false.

diagnostic_booleans.coap_retry_failure_callback_reported: After the final deadline is dispatched, coap_retransmit invokes the nack handler with COAP_NACK_TOO_MANY_RETRIES; this diagnostic is not the bounded result AP.

correlation_key: local endpoint + remote endpoint + transport protocol + Message ID + queue-node generation + retransmit_cnt
projection_rule: retain one exchange through its stored final-wait deadline and subsequent diagnostic action; a later legitimate reuse of the Message ID starts a new generation
instrumentation_timing: emit the trigger after retransmit_cnt becomes 4 and the final absolute deadline is committed; emit deadline-reached when monotonic time crosses it; separately record the later COAP_NACK_TOO_MANY_RETRIES callback as a diagnostic Boolean, not as the bounded result
review_question: 确认 final-wait AP 绑定已存储绝对期限而非 nack callback，且第五次发送 AP 不会把新 generation 的同 MID 报文算入旧交换。
limitations: 32000--48000 ms 是默认随机初值的派生范围；COAP_NACK_TOO_MANY_RETRIES callback 仅作为期限到达后的诊断布尔，不参与有界结果；本条不机械展开其他周期。
independent_audit_note: Root review replaced callback completion with the final absolute deadline, preserved the no-fifth-send safety oracle, and required early plus late/missing deadline counterexamples.

title: All retransmissions stay inside the 45-second transmit span
natural_language: 使用 RFC 7252 默认传输参数时，同一 CON 的最后一次重传最晚可在初次发送后 45000 ms 发生；45000 ms 之后不得再重传该交换。
standard_excerpt: the entire sequence of (re-)transmissions MUST stay in the envelope of MAX_TRANSMIT_SPAN
pointwise_semantics: strict pointwise; finite word; absolute integer milliseconds
finite_end_semantics: the supplied finite word is checked through its terminal observation; omitted APs are false

ap_definitions.coap_con_initial_sent: The first datagram of one correlated Confirmable exchange is successfully written.
ap_definitions.coap_same_con_retransmitted: coap_send_pdu successfully writes a later datagram for the same queue-node generation and Message ID.

correlation_key: local endpoint + remote endpoint + transport protocol + Message ID + queue-node generation
projection_rule: correlate all wire sends to one queue-node generation before projection; do not merge a later Message ID reuse
instrumentation_timing: timestamp each successful coap_send_pdu completion and retain the queue-node generation until ACK/RST/cancel/failure
review_question: 确认开放下界 (45000,infty) 允许规范给出的 45000 ms 边界，并要求测试词覆盖边界两侧。
limitations: 有限词的 POSITIVE 只说明给定观察词内没有越界重传；实际采集必须持续到交换结束或声明的终止观察点。45 s 常数定义保留为额外源码证据，主映射使用真实 initial/retransmit send hooks。
independent_audit_note: Root review moved the primary source mapping to the actual initial and retransmission send hooks and retained the MAX_TRANSMIT_SPAN macro as additional evidence.

title: A matching ACK or Reset stops retransmission
natural_language: 发送端收到与活动 CON 匹配的 ACK 或 RST 后，该 queue-node generation 的重传序列结束，之后不得再次发送同一交换。
standard_excerpt: until it receives an acknowledgement (or Reset message) or runs out of attempts
pointwise_semantics: strict pointwise; finite word; absolute integer milliseconds
finite_end_semantics: post-discharge absence is checked over all remaining positions of the finite word

ap_definitions.coap_matching_ack_or_reset_received: coap_dispatch receives an ACK or RST whose endpoint and Message ID match the current exchange, and coap_remove_from_queue removes that exact queue-node generation.
ap_definitions.coap_same_con_retransmitted: coap_send_pdu successfully writes a later datagram for the same queue-node generation and Message ID.

correlation_key: local endpoint + remote endpoint + transport protocol + Message ID + queue-node generation
projection_rule: match the ACK/RST to an active sendqueue node first, then keep only events for that node generation through the terminal observation
instrumentation_timing: emit ACK/RST only after coap_remove_from_queue returns the matching node; mark that generation closed before any later send event is projected
review_question: 确认 ACK/RST AP 只在成功匹配活动 sendqueue node 时置真，未知或重复控制报文不得触发该性质。
limitations: 该义务没有有限协议截止时间；有限词通过仅是该词上的判定，采集终点必须与 queue-node generation 的生命周期一致。
independent_audit_note: Root review confirmed ACK/RST discharge is emitted only after active-node matching and that finite weak monitoring must end with the correlated generation lifecycle.

auxiliary_source_mappings.role: subsequent send for the same queue-node generation

title: A Message ID is not reused within 247 seconds
natural_language: 默认 EXCHANGE_LIFETIME=247000 ms；同一通信端点对中的 Message ID 在首次使用后的该开放窗口内不得再次用于新的 CON 或 NON 消息。
standard_excerpt: The same Message ID MUST NOT be reused (in communicating with the same endpoint) within the EXCHANGE_LIFETIME
pointwise_semantics: strict pointwise; finite word; absolute integer milliseconds
finite_end_semantics: trace covers the complete 247000 ms reuse window; omitted APs are false

ap_definitions.coap_mid_first_used: A new outbound CON or NON generation first uses the tracked Message ID for one fixed local/remote endpoint pair.
ap_definitions.coap_same_mid_reused: A distinct outbound message generation uses that same Message ID with the same endpoint pair before the window ends.

correlation_key: local IP/port + remote IP/port + transport protocol + 16-bit Message ID; message generation distinguishes reuse from retransmission
projection_rule: group by endpoint pair and Message ID, classify retransmissions as the existing generation, then project first-use/reuse APs
instrumentation_timing: emit after a newly allocated MID is attached to a first-send PDU; the adapter retains endpoint-pair MID history for 247000 ms
review_question: 确认把 247000 ms 边界解释为开放窗口终点，并由 adapter 区分同一 generation 的重传与新消息复用。
limitations: 固定源码仅展示每会话递增分配点；247 秒历史保持与 endpoint-pair generation 分类属于观测适配器职责。
independent_audit_note: Root review accepts the RFC obligation and allocator hook, with the explicit caveat that 247-second endpoint-pair history and generation classification are supplied by the observation adapter rather than libcoap retention code.

title: A committed multicast response is sent within the five-second default leisure
natural_language: 服务器已经决定响应 multicast 请求、又没有可用于计算 Leisure 的数据时，libcoap 默认 profile 在 0--5000 ms 的 DEFAULT_LEISURE 内选择随机时刻发送单播响应。
standard_excerpt: The server SHOULD then pick a random point of time within the chosen leisure period
pointwise_semantics: strict pointwise; finite word; absolute integer milliseconds
finite_end_semantics: trace extends beyond 5000 ms; omitted APs are false

ap_definitions.coap_multicast_response_committed_defaul: The request arrived via multicast, the resource handler committed a response, delay suppression is off, and the default leisure queue path is selected.
ap_definitions.coap_multicast_response_sent: The queued unicast response for that requester token and responder endpoint is successfully written.

correlation_key: incoming multicast request token + responder local endpoint + request generation + response queue node
projection_rule: correlate the committed response to one multicast request and responder before projecting; tokens and addresses remain fields
instrumentation_timing: emit the trigger after the random delay is stored and coap_wait_ack inserts the multicast node; emit sent after the delayed write succeeds
review_question: 确认实验 profile 未设置自定义 default_leisure，也未启用 per-resource multicast delay suppression。
limitations: 规范允许应用计算其他 Leisure；本条只覆盖 RFC 默认值和固定 libcoap 默认 delayed-response 路径。negative 与命名附加反例均覆盖 5000 ms 后仍缺少发送的 late/missing 情形。
independent_audit_note: Root review confirmed the property is limited to the default-leisure delayed-response path and that its existing negative trace is the late/missing eventuality case.
